amāns

amāns, amantis

adjective (participle of amō)

loving, fond; lover, someone in love

In this lexicon

  • love

    also used · classical · Lewis & Short, s.v. amō; Traupman 155, 342, 149; Andresian p. 36

  • lover

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. And. 3.3.23: amantium īrae amōris integrātiōst (Lewis & Short, s.v. amō); Verg. A. 4.296: quis fallere possit amantem? (Lewis & Short)

  • amāns patriae: patriotic

    classical
